title: Naked100 Salt Nic E-Liquid – Pineapple Berry 30ml
description:
Description
Pineapple Berry decadent and fruity. Pineapple Berry is the definitive blend of crisp and tart Pineapple and sweet and ripe strawberry with a rich cream that adds just the right amount of depth and body.
Naked100 Salt E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Naked100 Salt E-Liquid is intended for small form factor, fillable pod systems. Ensure your customers are properly informed as Naked100 Salt E-Liquid contains significantly higher levels of nicotine per milliliter.
50% VG 50% PG
